meta.warning: SYNTHETIC. These members do not exist. Records are invented to stand in for an authenticated lookup against Humana's member systems.
meta.whyThisExists: The first version of the member surface had no identity step at all. The assistant would discuss 'your plan' having never established which plan that was — it only worked because the demo prompt happened to volunteer enough detail. A UAT reviewer caught it immediately: 'how did the app know who Linda is and what plan she has?' That is the right question, and the honest answer was that it didn't.
meta.productionReplacement: An authenticated session against Humana's member platform, returning current plan enrollment, providers on file, and the pharmacy record. This is also the point at which PHI enters the system — a signed-in session is the boundary the whole privacy posture hangs on.
meta.guestPathMatters: Not every shopper has an account. Someone newly eligible has never had one, and a caregiver may be helping before access is delegated. So identity is established EITHER by sign-in or by asking — never assumed.
